notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that share a creature type if Staff of Domination is on the battlefield or two creatures that share a creature type otherwise.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
If Staff of Domination is on the battlefield, activate its third ability by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}. untapping it.
If Staff of Domination is exiled by Myr Welder, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
